title: Penetration Testing Configuration Schema
description: Schema for YAML configuration files used in the penetration testing agent

authentication.description: Authentication configuration for the target application. Provide EITHER 'credentials' (legacy single-user) OR 'personas' (multi-role testing) — not both.

login_url.description: URL for the login page or endpoint (default for all personas)

credentials.description: Legacy single-user credentials. Auto-migrated to personas: [{ name: 'default', credentials: ... }] at parse time.

personas.description: List of personas/roles to test. Each persona has its own credentials and optional login overrides. Enables cross-role IDOR/privilege-escalation testing in a single run.

login_flow.description: Step-by-step instructions for the login process (default for all personas — can be overridden per persona).

type.description: Type of success condition to check

value.description: Value to match against the success condition

pipeline.description: Pipeline execution settings for retry behavior and concurrency

retry_preset.description: Retry preset. 'subscription' extends timeouts for Anthropic subscription rate limit windows (5h+).

mode.description: The testing mode (defaults to whitebox if not specified)

target.description: The target platform (defaults to web if not specified). 'network' selects the network graybox tier (15 agents, AD + protocol + service attacks).

network.description: Network graybox pipeline settings. Required when pipeline.target is 'network'.

engagement_mode.description: Engagement perspective. external = no foothold, internet-facing only. internal = assumed-breach / VPN-equivalent. hybrid = both. Default: hybrid.

targets.description: IP addresses, CIDR ranges, or hostnames in scope.

excludes.description: IPs/CIDRs/hostnames explicitly out of scope (must not be probed).

ad.description: Active Directory settings. Disabled = skip the network-ad-* agents.

domain.description: AD domain name, e.g. corp.local. Auto-discovered when omitted.

dc_ip.description: Domain controller IP for explicit targeting. Auto-discovered when omitted.

vuln_scanner.description: FOSS one-shot (nuclei), heavy compliance-grade (openvas), licensed (nessus), or skip entirely.

nessus_license_env.description: Environment variable name holding the Nessus license key. Required when vuln_scanner is 'nessus'.

relay.description: Broadcast-domain relay attack settings (LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS/IPv6). Disabled by default — opt-in only.

network_mode.description: host = multicast works (required for Responder/mitm6). bridge = isolated, multicast fails.

wordlist.description: Path to wordlist inside the container. Defaults to a bundled rockyou subset.

lockout_threshold.description: Max auth attempts per user per hour (password spray, brute force).

coercion_authorized.description: Permit PetitPotam/DFSCoerce/PrinterBug against production DCs. Off by default — requires explicit RoE approval.

avoid_production_dcs.description: If true, exploit-ad refuses to attempt operations that could destabilize production DCs.

attack_framework.description: MITRE ATT&CK version pinning for technique tagging.

attack_version.description: ATT&CK release version. Pinned so technique IDs are stable; update intentionally.

mobile.description: Mobile app configuration. Required when pipeline.target is 'mobile'.

app_path.description: Path to the APK (Android) or IPA (iOS) file

device_id.description: Specific device or emulator ID (e.g. emulator-5554)

backend_api_url.description: Backend API URL for traffic interception and API testing

bundle_id.description: iOS bundle ID or Android package name (e.g. com.example.app)

rules.description: Testing rules that define what to focus on or avoid during penetration testing

avoid.description: Rules defining areas to avoid during testing

focus.description: Rules defining areas to focus on during testing

context.description: Optional context for gray-box testing. Provides schema locations to guide discovery without full source code access.

schemas.description: API schema locations to seed the discovery agent (OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL).

credentials.description: Login credentials for a single user/persona

totp_secret.description: TOTP secret for two-factor authentication (Base32 encoded, case insensitive)

persona.description: A persona/role to test. Has its own credentials and optional login overrides.

name.description: Identifier for this persona (used in deliverable filenames, must be filesystem-safe)

role.description: Human-readable role description (e.g. 'administrator', 'viewer'). Surfaced in prompts and reports.

login_url.description: Override the default login_url for this persona only

login_flow.description: Override the default login_flow for this persona only

schemaHint.description: A pointer to an API schema the discovery agent should ingest.

url.description: URL path relative to the target (e.g. /api-docs/swagger.json) or absolute URL.

type.description: Schema format: openapi, swagger, or graphql (introspection).
Type of rule (what aspect of requests to match against)

url_path.description: URL path pattern or value to match
